title: types: two spec-alignment tests still author `addRecord.mode` / `formView`, which objectstack PR #24970 retired, so the Spec Shape Gate compiles objectui main red
body:
Filing gate ①: a follow-up that landed spec work owes (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24692, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24970). The reach is a named objectui test file that fails `type-check` against objectstack `main`, read in the hourly `Spec Shape Gate`. Filed by objectstack `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6023) · `os-warren` · session `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, for objectstack-ai/objectstack#25055. ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are this repository's triage.

**Reader who acts:** this repository's triage routes it to the seat that owns `packages/types`. It is due now: objectstack's hourly `Spec Shape Gate` compiles objectui `main` against the spec built from objectstack `main`, not against the pin.

## What changed upstream

objectstack PR #24970 (merge commit `fde7456352318872704c24feadaa6660b9bc649b`, 2026-10-20) retires `addRecord.mode` and `addRecord.formView` through ADR-0087 drop conversions and `retiredKey()` tombstones, and makes `enabled` required. `position` keeps `top` / `bottom` / `both` and now defaults to `top`.

## What objectui still does (read at objectui `main` `2794254099`)

Two tests author both retired keys on a typed value. Each line is a `TS2322` (`Type 'string' is not assignable to type '{ '[REMOVED] Key retired: run \`os validate\` for its migration.': never; }'`) in the gate run `39565602478` at objectstack `c67f244f5a`:

| File | Lines | What it authors |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/p2-spec-exports.test.ts` | `:143`, `:144` | `const config: AddRecordConfig = { enabled: true, position: 'top', mode: 'inline', formView: 'new-contact-form' }` ("should validate a full AddRecordConfig") |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts` | `:184`, `:185` | `addRecord: { enabled: true, position: 'top', mode: 'inline', formView: 'quick_create' }` on a `ListViewSchema` ("should accept addRecord configuration"). `:189` then reads `schema.addRecord?.mode` |

No objectui source writes `mode` or `formView`. PR #24970 checked this with `git grep` at the pin.

## The fix compiles on both sides now

Drop `mode` and `formView` from both authored values, and drop the `:189` `mode` assertion. At the pin (`@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0) both keys are optional, so the shorter value type-checks there too. The fix can land before the pin moves.

## Acceptance

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` exits 0 against the pin and against a spec built from objectstack `main`.
- Neither test authors or reads `addRecord.mode` or `addRecord.formView`.

## The registry entry this card carries

objectstack registers this retirement in `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json` with `downstream_card` = this card, so the gate reads these four diagnostics as `known` instead of red. Once this card's fix is on objectui `main`, the gate lists the entry as "matched nothing in this run". The entry is deleted when this card closes.

## Dedupe

- `search_issues` on objectui, "addRecord mode formView retired key spec test p2-spec-exports": 17 hits, none open. #13099 (closed) is ruling item 4's create-entry card. PR #24970 names its `:189` parity row as changing at the pin bump, and that is earlier than this gate reads it. #10987 (closed) is the same class for the list view's `tabs`.
- Dedupe words: addRecord mode formView retired, p1-spec-alignment addRecord, p2-spec-exports AddRecordConfig, Spec Shape Gate addRecord.
